description.value:
You unleash a Force-amplified shriek at every creature you choose within 60 feet of you. Each must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 6d6 psychic damage and 6d6 sonic damage, be blinded and deafened for 1 minute, and fall prone; a successful save halves the damage and prevents the blindness, deafness, and knockdown.

A creature blinded by this power may attempt another Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the blindness on a success.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 8
